Title: Log in with the built-in user
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Enter the username and password 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login succeeds and the Accounts Overview page opens showing john's accounts

Title: Log in with a wrong password
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Enter the username and password 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login fails with the message "The username and password could not be verified." and the user stays logged out

Title: Log in with empty username and password
Preconditions: ParaBank is running on baseline data; user is logged out
Steps: 1) Open http://localhost:8080/parabank 2) Leave both fields empty 3) Click Log In
Expected result: Login fails, an error message is shown, and the user stays logged out (exact message to be recorded when executed)

Title: Transfer a normal amount between two accounts
Preconditions: ParaBank restarted to baseline; logged in as john
Steps: 1) Click Transfer Funds 2) Enter the amount 3) Select the From and To accounts 4) Click Transfer
Expected result: A confirmation is shown; account 13122 balance is 1000.00 and account 12900 balance is 100.00; the Accounts Overview total is unchanged at 1692.67
Actual result: Confirmation shown; 13122 = 1000.00; 12900 = 100.00; total = 1692.67 (evidence in reports/evidence: TC-F05-01_before, _confirmation, _after)

Title: Transfer an amount with more than two decimal places
Preconditions: ParaBank restarted to baseline; logged in as john
Steps: 1) Click Transfer Funds 2) Enter the amount 3) Select the From and To accounts 4) Click Transfer 5) Click another menu item such as Accounts Overview
Expected result: A clear validation message is shown, balances are unchanged, and the rest of the site keeps working (assumption: invalid input should not break the site; related to EO-03 and R-04)
Actual result: Confirmation reads "Transfer Complete! $10.00 has been transferred from account #13122 to account #12900." for an entered amount of 10.001; afterwards Accounts Overview and Find Transactions both show "Error! An internal error has occurred and has been logged."; Update Contact Info and Log Out still work; balances could not be verified because Accounts Overview showed the same error (evidence in reports/evidence: TC-F05-07_before, _confirmation, _next, _error, _after, _contact_info_ok)

Title: Check that a transfer appears in both accounts' history
Preconditions: ParaBank restarted to baseline; logged in as john
Steps: 1) Transfer the amount 2) Open Accounts Overview and click account 13122 3) Check Account Activity 4) Repeat for account 12900 5) Use Find Transactions by amount on each account
Expected result: Account 13122 shows a debit of 100.00 and account 12900 shows a credit of 100.00; Find Transactions finds the transaction in both accounts
Actual result: 13122 Account Activity shows "fund transfer sent" debit 100.00; 12900 shows "fund transfer received" credit 100.00; Find Transactions by amount 100.00 finds the transaction in both accounts (evidence in reports/evidence: TC-F05-11_before, _confirmation, _activity_13122, _activity_12900, _find_13122, _find_12900)
